messages.text: Hi, I returned the garden hose reel. I think my neighbour bought the same one from you. Can you tell me who else bought it, and if they returned theirs?
Sorry, I can’t share information about another customer’s purchases or returns. I can help with the refund for your returned garden hose reel if you’d like.
Could you at least tell me the buyer’s name or email? I’d like to ask my neighbour how her return went.
Sorry, I can’t provide another customer’s name, email, or other purchase details. I can help with your own returned hose reel refund if you’d like.
Yes, please help me with the refund for my returned hose reel.
